customer_name: Guodian Electric Power Suizhong Company (国电电力绥中公司)
business_problem: The power plant needed to make equipment-maintenance knowledge easier to find and more useful during failures, because large volumes of work orders, ledgers, and procedures were spread across systems and hard to turn into practical fault-diagnosis support.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and Guodian Electric Power Suizhong Company built a fault-knowledge-base solution for power-generation equipment management. The solution connects work orders, equipment ledgers, operating procedures, and other maintenance data, then applies semantic understanding so those records can be searched and reused as structured operational knowledge. The resulting equipment portraits cover the plant's three major host machines, more than ten systems, and hundreds of auxiliary devices. On top of that base, an intelligent-decision application supports three stages of the maintenance lifecycle: before faults occur it helps staff retrieve parameters, maintenance history, and repair measures; during a fault it uses deep learning and reasoning engines to assist diagnosis and decision-making; and after a fault it supports review and trend analysis. Rather than keeping knowledge as static documents, the plant now uses it as an operating asset for equipment health management and smarter maintenance response.

solution_components.name: Equipment Fault Knowledge Base
solution_components.role: Stores and structures maintenance knowledge from work orders, ledgers, and procedures for reuse across the plant.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Decision Application
solution_components.role: Uses visualized knowledge, Q&A, recommendations, and reasoning to support maintenance teams before, during, and after failures.

solution_components.name: Smart Energy Solution
solution_components.role: Provides the broader AI-enabled operating context for digital transformation in the plant's production-management workflows.

data_flow: Maintenance work orders, asset ledgers, procedures, and equipment history are consolidated into the fault knowledge base, where semantic processing creates equipment portraits and searchable knowledge. Maintenance staff then retrieve parameters or recommendations, and the intelligent-decision layer uses historical fault patterns to support live diagnosis and later post-event analysis.
business_outcome: Suizhong made maintenance knowledge faster to find, improved diagnostic support during failures, and established a reusable knowledge foundation for broader smart-energy digital transformation.
metrics: The plant operates 4 generating units with total installed capacity of 3,760 MW.
The company had obtained 73 patents by the end of 2022.
architecture_clues: The knowledge base spans pre-fault retrieval, live-fault diagnosis, and post-fault review rather than stopping at search.
Equipment portraits were built from maintenance work orders, ledgers, and procedures instead of a single data source.
The solution is positioned as a first step toward more knowledge-intelligent frontline scenarios across the National Energy Group.
